notes.title: Demo out now!
notes.notes:
I’m happy to announce that the Sibling Souls demo is finally published. In the demo, you’ll get to know Lina’s family, the main characters, and the story premise. It features roughly 10,000 words, while the main game will likely have around 100,000 words (due to the different routes and the many important decisions that can lead to various endings).

The game is still in development and is currently planned to release by the end of the year.

I hope you enjoy the demo!
